Tilak Varma's 'Dead Ball' Controversy in India-Pakistan Match

A face-off occurred between Indian cricketer Tilak Varma and Pakistan during a match in Doha following a 'dead ball' call. Varma expressed regret over the incident, stating, 'Why penalise us?' He also lamented the lack of partnerships in India's defeat to Pakistan, adding, 'I could have finished the game.'
